# SMSify

A Laravel package for sending SMS through various gateways.

Forked from [iRaziul/barta](https://github.com/iRaziul/barta) and maintained internally for UddoktaPay. We renamed the package and its classes to SMSify so we don't depend on a third-party package for updates and maintenance.
